self.text: Hey there! I’m a mid‑30s Kenyan guy who’s currently studying programming. I love getting my hands on code and tackling puzzles, and I thrive when I can work through problems together with someone else. I’m all about collaboration and learning by doing. Outside of coding, I’m a bit of a podcaster – I enjoy sharing stories and insights on history and tech over a good conversation. I’m open to meeting in person, and I’m free on Saturday afternoons or Sunday afternoons if you’re around. Let’s grab a coffee and dive into a coding challenge or chat about our latest podcast episode. Looking forward to connecting!
